manufacturerInfo.description: Generic model of a 7.3 x 7.3 x 3.2 mm shielded drum + ring power inductor, 4.7 uH. Footprint, height, inductance, DC resistance, core material class and pads are published values of such a part; the drum/ring proportions, the winding and the ferrite grade are not (see provenance).

part.description: shielded drum + ring power inductor, 7.3 x 7.3 x 3.2 mm case, NiZn ferrite

provenance.sourceName: published parametric catalogue record of a 7.3 x 7.3 x 3.2 mm drum + ring power inductor, 4.7 uH
fields: mechanical (7.3 x 7.3 mm, 7.6 max; height 3.2 mm, 3.5 max)
core shape B = part height, J = M = footprint side

provenance.sourceName: published datasheet of the same family (bottom view)
fields: coil connections padWidth / padDepth 1.5 x 1.5 mm (terminal size)

provenance.derivation: E = B - D - F (drum convention D + E + F == B) and L = B - F (the seated ring reaches from the plate top to the top of the part), with B the published 3.2 mm part height.

Wire INFERRED, not published: with the 9 turns held, the existing MAS round wire whose MKF-computed DC resistance at 25 C (WindingOhmicLosses::calculate_dc_resistance_per_winding, real winding geometry: turns as laid plus the routed terminal leads) is nearest the published 33 mOhm typical; 'Round 0.25 - Grade 1' gives 33.72 mOhm (29.75 mOhm with the idealised winding, no leads). The winding's inductance is NOT used in the inference.
NOT published: numberTurns 9, the drum flanges (A 5.3 mm, D = F = 0.55 mm), post C 2.5 mm, ring bore K 5.7 mm and plate chamfer N 0 are the earlier corpus fixture's assumptions, kept unchanged.
fields: core shape A, C, D, F, K, N

provenance.derivation: STAND-IN: the family's published data gives the core material class (NiZn) but no permeability or grade; the MAS power-application NiZn ferrite '4F1' stands in. Inductance computed with it is not a prediction of the real part and is not tuned to the published 4.7 uH.
